company.name: Chicago Parking Meters, LLC
company.description: Chicago-based concessionaire that operates, manages and maintains approximately 36,000 on-street metered parking spaces under the City of Chicago's 75-year concession and markets the system through ParkChicago.

milestones.event: MSIP / Morgan Stanley Infrastructure's consortium was selected as winning bidder for the 75-year Chicago parking meter concession.
Chicago Parking Meters, LLC was formed.
The MSIP / Morgan Stanley Infrastructure-led consortium, including ADIA and Allianz, reached financial close on the 75-year Chicago parking meter concession for $1.151 billion.
The city and concessionaire amended portions of the operating relationship following early implementation disputes.
Chicago officials stated the city would not pursue a buyback of the concession in the near term.
Chicago Parking Meters requested City approval for the proposed transfer of all ownership interests to Stonepeak affiliates after the sellers accepted Stonepeak's bid.

sources.label: Close date source — Allianz Global Investors — Chicago Parking Meters, LLC
sources.evidenceLabel: Confirms the 75-year concession, February 2009 close and original consortium including Morgan Stanley, Allianz Capital Partners and ADIA.

sources.label: Parkchicago — Chicago Parking Meters, LLC
sources.evidenceLabel: Establishes the legal and operating identity, CPM and ParkChicago aliases, concessionaire role, approximately 36,000 on-street metered spaces, 2009 operating start and the 75-year concession.

sources.label: City of Chicago — Ordinance authorizing approval of the proposed ownership transfer of Chicago Parking Meters, LLC
sources.evidenceLabel: Names Deeside Investments, Inc. as a direct owner and Allianz SE and ADIA as its indirect owners; states that the sellers accepted Stonepeak affiliates' bid, that the buyer would own 100% after consummation, and that City approval was requested on March 12, 2026.

sources.label: Allianz Global Investors — Our history

sources.label: Infralogic / ION Analytics — Concessionaire preps Chicago Parking Meters sale
sources.evidenceLabel: Reports February 2009 financial close and sponsor stakes of 50.1% for North Haven Infrastructure Partners, 25.0% for Allianz Capital Partners and 24.9% for ADIA; it also identifies ParkChicago as an alias.

sources.label: Chicago Sun-Times — Ald. Ervin proposes 'infrastructure trust' to weigh taking back parking meters
sources.evidenceLabel: Identifies the Morgan Stanley-Allianz-ADIA consortium as the current owner and reports that the City Council had until September 30 to accept or reject Stonepeak's offer, confirming that the transfer remained unclosed.
